specs.Compatible Devices: laptops, smartphones, tablets, gaming consoles, media players

features: Wireless Connectivity: Supports Wi-Fi, Miracast and Bluetooth for seamless connection to your smartphone, tablet, or other devices. Stream content wirelessly and enjoy the freedom of a cable-free experience. Versatile Input Options: Includes HDMI, USB, and AUX, providing flexibility to connect multiple devices such as laptops, game consol.
High-Definition Projection: Projects clear, sharp images in Full HD (1080p) resolution. Experience detailed visuals and vivid colours with a brightness level suitable for various lighting conditions.
Integrated Speakers: Features built-in high-quality speakers that deliver clear audio, enhancing your viewing experience.

Android Operating System: Comes pre-installed with the Android, allowing you to download apps directly from the Google Play Store. Enjoy streaming services like Netflix, YouTube, and more without needing an external device.
description: Upgrade your home entertainment experience with the Nutts Mini Portable Projector, designed for crystal-clear visuals and modern style. Its sleek cylindrical design with a stable stand allows flexible positioning on any surface, making it perfect for movies, gaming, office presentations, and classroom use. Featuring a high-quality projection lens, this projector delivers sharp, bright, and vibrant visuals even in medium-light environments. The compact body ensures easy portability, while the included remote control provides smooth, hassle-free operation from anywhere in the room.
